review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous category-theoretic framework unifying information measures across quantum mechanics, general relativity, and other physical theories. This would require: (1) A category PhysStates with objects representing state spaces from different physical theories, (2) A category InfoMeasures with morphisms preserving information-theoretic properties, (3) A functor I: PhysStates → InfoMeasures that consistently maps physical constraints to information constraints, (4) Proof that this functor is faithful and preserves relevant structure
